title: 21 July 1961: Live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (lunchtime)
content:
This was The Beatles’ 17th lunchtime performance at the Cavern Club on Liverpool’s Mathew Street.

The group’s lunchtime shows typically lasted from 12-2pm. This was their 20th show at the Cavern overall, including evening performances.

Although the precise number of their Cavern appearances is not known, The Beatles played at least 155 lunchtime and 125 evening shows between 9 February 1961 and 3 August 1963.

Page last updated: 24 January 2024
